mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `transaction` ( user_id, account_id, expense_category_id, ex_transaction_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, transacted_at, merchant_name ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{expenseCategoryId}, #{exTransactionId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{transactedAt}, #{merchantName} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id = VALUES(account_id), expense_category_id = VALUES(expense_category_id), amount = VALUES(amount), balance_after = VALUES(balance_after), transacted_at = VALUES(transacted_at), merchant_name = VALUES(merchant_name)
